summary: Specifies ways to communicate route exclusions when setting up paths with RSVP-TE. It builds on RFC 3209 and the GMPLS extensions of RFC 3473, which allow explicit route hints, and lets a requester say which nodes or links the path must avoid. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: When planning a trip, you can say, go anywhere except through that muddy road. This lets a network path request say what places to avoid.
